name: Recital M
title: REPORT on the protection of the European Union’s financial interests – combating fraud – annual report 2023
part_text: whereas the rule of law conditionality mechanism applies across the entire EU budget as a prerequisite for accessing all EU funds and allows measures to be taken in cases of breaches of the rule of law principles that affect or seriously risk affecting the sound financial management of the EU budget or the EU’s financial interests;
